data.action: 踩在岩石上舒展腰身投掷苦无，身体前倾发力，枫叶随劲风环绕飞舞
data.camera: full body, dynamic action wide shot, low perspective
data.description: 【常陆茉子 · 红枫树下的忍道飞掷】漫山遍野红枫如烈火燃烧的后山林道中，秋风卷起漫天赤色落叶。茉子身体微沉踏在一块青苔古岩上，右手正精准将一枚锋利苦无脱手掷出。破空呼啸的气流带起翻飞的枫叶，黑色短发与忍者服下摆在动静之间展露出极致的力量美与矫健身手。
data.lighting: 浓烈深秋枫树冠层透出的金红漫射光与苦无金属反光
data.location: 红枫密林深处落叶林道
data.promptProse: Mako lowers her stance on a moss-covered rock along the autumn forest path and releases a kunai accurately from her right hand. Her shinobi top, guarded forearms and wrap skirt over safety shorts remain fully framed, black hair and hem moving among red leaves. The low wide view follows the rocky path behind. Gold-red canopy light catches the thrown blade and leaf edges, leaving cool moss shadows beneath her grounded feet.
data.title: 常陆茉子 · 红枫树下的忍道飞掷
